stated: The Conservative Party will bring forward a landmark Tobacco and Vapes Bill in their first King's Speech to restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt, and sugar, and gather evidence on ultra-processed food.

source.quote: We will bring forward our landmark Tobacco and Vapes Bill in our first King’s Speech. We will continue to tackle childhood and adult obesity and will legislate to restrict the advertising of products high in fat, salt and sugar.

bearing_set.reason: Restricting HFSS advertising is a public-health intervention with a plausible (if contested) effect on population diet, obesity rates, and consequent NHS demand — earning a real verdict on healthcare access and capacity.

Advertising restrictions on tobacco, vaping products and HFSS foods constrain commercial free expression for producers, advertisers and media, a non-negligible coercive state restriction on speech that clears the O10 bar even if the targets are already partially regulated.

membership_note: Primary bearing is O3 (the public-health mechanism is well-evidenced and large); the advertising ban is a genuine, if secondary, O10 liberty cost via commercial-speech restriction. Gathering evidence on UPF is too weak an action to add further bearings. Fiscal and inequality effects are indirect and below the non-negligible threshold.
